name: kiriya

tools.name: completion
tools.description: Print the completion script for a shell; its first lines say how to load it

tools.name: completion.suggest
tools.description: Print what can come next on a command line, for the completion scripts to show

current.description: The word being completed, which may be empty <word>

word.description: A word before it on the command line, once for each word <word>

tools.name: config.get
tools.description: Print one setting, one value per line

tools.name: config.keys
tools.description: List every setting kiriya reads

tools.name: config.list
tools.description: List the settings in the configuration file

tools.name: config.path
tools.description: Print where the configuration file is, whether or not it exists yet

tools.name: convert.base64
tools.description: Encode text or a file as base64, or decode base64 back to text

value.description: The text to convert; - or nothing reads what is piped in

file.description: Read a file's exact bytes instead <path>

url.description: Use the URL-safe alphabet, without padding

tools.name: convert.case
tools.description: Change the case of text, line by line: kebab, snake, camel, pascal, constant, title, lower or upper

value.description: The text to convert; - or nothing reads what is piped in

file.description: Read a file's exact bytes instead <path>

tools.name: convert.hex
tools.description: Encode text or a file as hexadecimal, or decode hexadecimal back to text

value.description: The text to convert; - or nothing reads what is piped in

file.description: Read a file's exact bytes instead <path>

tools.name: convert.json
tools.description: Format, minify, check or read a value out of JSON, pointing at any error

value.description: The text to convert; - or nothing reads what is piped in

get.description: Print what is at a dotted path, such as data.listeners.0.pid <path>

file.description: Read a file's exact bytes instead <path>

tools.name: convert.jwt
tools.description: Decode a JWT's header and payload on this machine; the signature is never checked and nothing is sent

value.description: The text to convert; - or nothing reads what is piped in

file.description: Read a file's exact bytes instead <path>

tools.name: convert.time
tools.description: Show a moment as ISO 8601, local time, and Unix seconds and milliseconds; now by default

value.description: Unix seconds or milliseconds, or a date such as 2026-01-31T12:00:00Z

unit.description: How to read a number: auto, seconds or ms; auto reads numbers below 100000000000 as seconds

tools.name: convert.url
tools.description: Percent-encode text for a URL, or decode it

value.description: The text to convert; - or nothing reads what is piped in

file.description: Read a file's exact bytes instead <path>

tools.name: docker.logs
tools.description: Show the project's logs, optionally following them

services.description: The services to act on; every service by default

file.description: The compose file; by default compose.yaml, compose.yml, docker-compose.yaml or docker-compose.yml here <compose.yaml>

tail.description: How many lines to show from the end of each log, or all; 200 by default <n|all>

tools.name: docker.ps
tools.description: List the containers of the compose project here, or every compose project

file.description: The compose file; by default compose.yaml, compose.yml, docker-compose.yaml or docker-compose.yml here <compose.yaml>

projects.description: List every compose project on this machine instead

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check what this machine gives kiriya: runtime, configuration, trash, clipboard, git, docker and plugins

tools.name: env.check
tools.description: Compare a .env file with its .env.example by variable name; values are never shown

file.description: The file to check; .env by default <path>

example.description: The file listing the variables expected; .env.example by default <path>

tools.name: env.path
tools.description: Check each folder in PATH, or another list variable, for missing, duplicate, empty and relative entries

variable.description: The variable to check; PATH by default

tools.name: env.show
tools.description: List environment variables, hiding values that look secret

filter.description: Only variables whose name contains this text, in any case

tools.name: files.compare
tools.description: Compare two files, or two folders, by content; exits 1 when they differ

all.description: In folders, include hidden entries and dependency folders

tools.name: files.dupes
tools.description: Find files with identical content, and the space their extra copies take

folder.description: The folder to search; the current folder by default

min-size.description: Ignore files smaller than this, such as 1MB <size>

all.description: Include hidden entries and dependency folders such as node_modules

tools.name: files.find
tools.description: Find files and folders by name, extension, type, size, age or emptiness

folder.description: The folder to search; the current folder by default

name.description: A glob that ignores case, such as *.test.ts or src/**/index.* <glob>

larger.description: Larger than a size, such as 10KB <size>

newer.description: Modified within a time, such as 7d, or after a date <time>

older.description: Modified before a time or date <time>

all.description: Include hidden entries and dependency folders such as node_modules

limit.description: Show at most this many results <n>

tools.name: files.grep
tools.description: Search text inside files with the same regular expressions on every OS

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression, or exact text with --literal

paths.description: Files, folders or globs to search; the current folder by default

literal.description: Search for the exact text instead of a regular expression

ext.description: Only files with these extensions, such as .ts,.tsx <extensions>

name.description: Only files whose name matches this glob, such as *.config.js <glob>

files-only.description: Print only the names of files with a match

count.description: Print the number of matches in each file

all.description: Include hidden entries and dependency folders such as node_modules

limit.description: Show at most this many matching lines; 500 by default <n>

tools.name: files.hash
tools.description: Print checksums of files, or check a file against a published checksum

check.description: The checksum a single file should have; exits 1 when it does not <hex>

tools.name: files.info
tools.description: Show type, size, dates and permissions of files or folders, and optionally a hash

hash.description: Also show a hash of each file

tools.name: files.list
tools.description: List a folder's entries with type, size and modification time

path.description: The folder or file to list; the current folder by default

all.description: Include hidden entries and dependency folders such as node_modules

sort.description: Sort by name, size or time

tools.name: files.read
tools.description: Print a text file, or part of it, in UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, UTF-16 LE or UTF-16 BE

tools.name: files.size
tools.description: Show the largest folders under a folder, with rebuildable dependency and cache folders called out

folder.description: The folder to measure; the current folder by default

top.description: How many folders to show; 15 by default <n>

tools.name: files.tree
tools.description: Show a folder as a tree, folders first

path.description: The folder to draw; the current folder by default

depth.description: How many levels to open; 3 by default <n>

all.description: Show hidden entries and open dependency folders such as node_modules

tools.name: gen.password
tools.description: Make passwords of letters, digits and symbols, every character equally likely

length.description: Characters in each password, from 8 to 256; 24 by default <n>

no-symbols.description: Leave symbols out, for systems that refuse them

count.description: How many to make; 1 by default <n>

tools.name: gen.token
tools.description: Make random tokens for secrets and API keys

bytes.description: Random bytes in each token, from 8 to 1024; 32 by default <n>

format.description: hex, base64 or base64url; base64url by default

count.description: How many to make; 1 by default <n>

tools.name: gen.ulid
tools.description: Make ULIDs: 26 characters that sort by the time they were made

count.description: How many to make; 1 by default <n>

tools.name: gen.uuid
tools.description: Make UUIDs: random version 4, or version 7 that sorts by creation time

v7.description: Make version 7 UUIDs, which sort by the time they were made

count.description: How many to make; 1 by default <n>

tools.name: git.status
tools.description: Show every repository under a folder: branch, commits, uncommitted files, unpushed work and remote

folder.description: A repository, or a folder holding repositories; the current folder by default

depth.description: How many folder levels to search for repositories; 3 by default <1-10>

tools.name: net.check
tools.description: Check whether a TCP port answers, such as db.internal:5432 or https://example.com

target.description: host:port, [IPv6]:port, or a URL whose scheme gives the port

timeout.description: Seconds to wait, from 1 to 120; 5 by default <seconds>

tools.name: net.dns
tools.description: Look up a name's addresses as programs here see them, or its DNS records of one type

name.description: The host name to look up

type.description: system (the default: the hosts file, then DNS), a, aaaa, cname, mx, txt or ns

tools.name: net.ip
tools.description: List this machine's network addresses

tools.name: port.free
tools.description: Print the first TCP port, from 3000 or --from, that nothing listens on and that can be opened

from.description: The first port to try; 3000 by default <port>

tools.name: port.who
tools.description: Show the processes listening on a TCP port, or on every port

port.description: The port; every listening port when left out

tools.name: proc.find
tools.description: Find processes whose name or command line contains some text

text.description: The text to look for, in any case

tools.name: proc.list
tools.description: List processes with their memory, sorted by name

name.description: Only processes whose name contains this text, in any case <text>

tools.name: proc.tree
tools.description: Show processes as a tree of parents and children, or the tree under one process

pid.description: The process whose tree to show; every process when left out

tools.name: sys.info
tools.description: Show the operating system, processor, memory, uptime, locale and runtime

tools.name: sys.report
tools.description: Print machine facts and tool versions as Markdown for a bug report, without the host name

tools.name: sys.tools
tools.description: Find node, python, dotnet, java, go, git and docker, and their versions

tools.name: wait.file
tools.description: Wait until a file or folder exists, or until it is gone with --gone

path.description: The file or folder to wait for

gone.description: Wait until it no longer exists instead

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up, from 1 to 3600; 60 by default <seconds>

tools.name: wait.port
tools.description: Wait until a TCP port accepts connections, or until nothing listens there with --gone

target.description: A port on this machine such as 5432, host:port, [IPv6]:port, or a URL whose scheme gives the port

gone.description: Wait until nothing listens there instead

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up, from 1 to 3600; 60 by default <seconds>

instructions: kiriya's developer tools, which behave the same on Windows, Linux and macOS. Every tool here only reads. Relative paths start at /pkg; paths outside /pkg are refused.
